Persistent work state and minimal context for long-running agents

Usage: awr [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  overview      Open the local project hub, or inspect its catalog and background service
  runtime       Inspect, back up and explicitly restore a matching local runtime
  organization  Maintain explicitly mapped project phase, scope and focus
  batch         Preview and apply a bounded batch of source edits
  host          Save explicit host edits with durable request identity and provenance
  document      Edit registered Markdown documents or create source-backed drafts
  capabilities  Negotiate host capabilities without opening a project or its database
  init          Preview source authority mapping; --accept initializes using the reviewed mapping
  intake        Diagnose project organization and recheck readiness after source edits
  client        Bind client conversations and persist lifecycle checkpoints
  execution     Register, run and inspect executions that can outlive the calling session
  recovery      Inspect saved work and verify execution evidence before resuming
  source        List, scan or index authoritative project sources
  nav           Read-only mainline navigation across scope, dependencies, accounting and blockers
  status        Refresh source projections and summarize current project work
  ready         List dependency-ready work with explicit reasons for excluded work
  assessment    Offline assessment replay, shadow compare, and advice kill-switch
  work          Read one work item without expanding the full ledger or event history
  session       Start, inspect, checkpoint or end an explicitly identified agent session
  evidence      Add evidence records or inspect a specific record and its report reference
  decision      Inspect a specific authoritative decision
  spec          Inspect explicit specification versions, supersessions and requirement coverage
  artifact      Import, inspect or explicitly read a registered artifact
  context       Compile revision-bound context after refreshing project sources
  object        Read one referenced goal, plan, rule, work item or checkpoint
  event         Append validated events or inspect immutable events and bounded history
  search        Search bounded summaries, optionally filtering by entity type, status or work item
  proposal      Create, inspect and review source-bound mutation proposals
  branch        Create, inspect or select an Agent Work Branch without changing Git checkout
  doctor        Diagnose project/database state; apply only explicitly selected runtime repairs
  workspace     Share tracked project files between machines through an object store
  team          Inspect Team protocol capabilities or submit a remote Team envelope
  remote        Store Team remote endpoint and credential environment references
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --project <PROJECT>  [default: .]
      --json               
  -h, --help               Print help
  -V, --version            Print version
